basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 103 Senior Residents/ Senior Demonstrator Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Guwahati Senior Resident / Senior Demonstrator Notification 2026 has been released on 02 September 2026 on the official website of AIIMS Guwahati. A total of 103 vacancies have been announced through the AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 across 33 departments on a tenure basis for a period of 3 years under the Central Residency Scheme.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Guwahati has officially released Notification No. 02-14/2021-22/AIIMS/GHY/ESTT/RECT(SR)/PART – II/808D(A) dated 02 September 2026 for recruitment of Senior Residents and Senior Demonstrators. The notification includes complete details on department-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, age limits, salary, application fee, required documents, selection process, reservation, interview and other important terms and conditions. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification carefully before applying. The notification is available on the official AIIMS Guwahati website. Download AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Apply Online Official Website

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Vacancy 2026: Department-wise Details
content_sections.text: The AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Vacancy 2026 is spread across 33 departments, with reservation as per Government of India norms (UR – Unreserved, OBC – Other Backward Classes, SC – Scheduled Caste, ST – Scheduled Tribe, EWS – Economically Weaker Section). An additional 4% of the total vacancies is horizontally reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). Vacancies are provisional and subject to variation by the Executive Director, AIIMS Guwahati. Note: In case suitable EWS candidates are not found, these posts will not be carried forward or treated as backlog, and Unreserved (UR) candidates may provisionally be allowed to apply against EWS posts.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: The AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Qualification requirement differs for medical, dental, and non-medical candidates. A Postgraduate Medical Degree (MD/MS/DNB) or equivalent in the relevant discipline from a recognised University/Institute, as per the Residency Scheme. All terms and conditions of the Scheme apply. MDS in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery from a recognised University/Institute, as per the Residency Scheme. The notification also specifies cross-department eligibility for super-specialty residency: candidates with MD/MS in General Medicine or General Surgery may apply for residency in medical and surgical super-specialty departments respectively; MD in Paediatrics qualifies for Neonatology; MD/MS in Emergency Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Orthopaedics, Anaesthesia, or General Surgery qualifies for Trauma & Emergency; MD in Pathology qualifies for Transfusion Medicine; and MD in Respiratory Medicine qualifies for Pulmonary Medicine. Medical super-specialties listed are Cardiology, Endocrinology, Gastroenterology, Medical Oncology/Haematology, Neonatology, Nephrology, Neurology, and Pulmonary Medicine; surgical super-specialties listed are Burns & Plastic Surgery, Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery, Neurosurgery, Paediatric Surgery, Surgical Gastroenterology, Surgical Oncology, and Urology. The notification states that detailed educational qualifications, age, and eligibility criteria for each department are available on the official AIIMS Guwahati website, so candidates should verify department-specific qualification requirements there before applying.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 is based purely on performance in a personal interview, after scrutiny of the online application and supporting documents. The list of eligible candidates, after scrutiny, is uploaded on the Institute website. Document Verification (DV) reporting time: 8:00 AM. Interview time: 9:00 AM onwards. Interview venue: Director's Board Room, Medical College Building, AIIMS Guwahati. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview. A separate merit list (selected and waiting list) is prepared for each category - UR, EWS, OBC, SC, and ST - based on the interview. Selected candidates must undergo document verification before the offer of appointment is issued. Any vacancy arising from non-joining or resignation of a selected candidate is offered to the next candidate on the waiting list as per merit. Candidates can apply for more than one post among the listed departments, but must submit a separate application form with separate fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must fill the online application along with the relevant documents. Before starting, candidates should keep the following ready: A valid, active e-mail ID (all correspondence, including interview schedules, will be sent by e-mail) Scanned passport-size photograph (JPG format) Scanned signature (JPG format) Scanned copies of relevant documents Candidates must ensure their photo and signature are clearly visible in the preview while filling the online form; applications with a small or unclear photo/signature will be rejected. The online application will close on the last date, and incomplete applications will not be considered. The notification directs candidates to the official AIIMS Guwahati website, https://aiimsguwahati.ac.in , for the application link, detailed schedule of interview, educational qualifications, and department-wise age and eligibility criteria. A direct apply-online URL is not specified in the notification itself, so candidates should check the official website for the live application link.

content_sections.heading: Other Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Candidates already employed in a Government Hospital/Institution must apply through proper channel and produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview/document verification. OBC candidates must submit a valid OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026, based on the Central List of OBCs. EWS candidates must submit an Income and Asset certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026, based on income for Financial Year 2026-27. PwBD candidates must submit a valid disability certificate issued by a duly constituted Medical Board. Candidates seeking reserved-category benefit or age relaxation must submit the requisite certificate at the time of document verification, failing which their claim will not be entertained. The post is whole-time, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Candidates may be posted at rural or urban health centres attached to the Institute. Residential accommodation is subject to availability; if not provided, HRA as admissible to Central Government servants will be paid. Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a rolling advertisement issued by AIIMS, Guwahati, inviting online applications for 103 Senior Resident/Senior Demonstrator posts across 33 departments, on a tenure basis for three years under the Central Residency Scheme.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 103 vacancies are available: 34 UR, 37 OBC, 17 SC, 7 ST, and 8 EWS, spread across 33 departments, with an additional 4% horizontal reservation for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 18.09.2026. The application window opened on 04.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Medical candidates need a Postgraduate Medical Degree (MD/MS/DNB) or equivalent under the Residency Scheme; dental candidates need MDS in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery; non-medical candidates need an M.Sc. and PhD in the relevant subject (Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or Pharmacology).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the closing date of online applications, with age relaxation of up to 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and additional relaxation for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 1,000/- for UR/OBC candidates and Rs. 500/- for SC/ST/EWS candidates, plus applicable transaction charges. There is no fee for PwBD candidates. The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill the online application on the official AIIMS Guwahati website with a valid e-mail ID, scanned photograph, scanned signature, and scanned copies of relevant documents, and pay the application fee online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Guwahati Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based solely on performance in a personal interview, conducted after scrutiny of the online application and required documents. Separate merit and waiting lists are prepared for each category.
